title: Email/set create: silent drop of malformed inReplyTo/references
description: build_email_from_create uses .ok() when deserializing inReplyTo and references. If client sends 'inReplyTo': 'not-an-array', the value is silently ignored (becomes None). Email is created without inReplyTo, wrong thread may be assigned, and client sees no error. Trigger: Email/set create with malformed inReplyTo or references → data silently dropped, wrong thread assignment.
